topic: the 1932 Emu War, where Australia's own army sent machine guns after emus and lost
title: Australia Sent Machine Guns to War Against Emus. The Birds Won.
description: The true story of the 1932 Emu War, where Australia's own army sent real machine guns after emus destroying wheat crops in Western Australia, and lost. AI-narrated historical commentary.

hook_candidates.text: The strangest wars a real army ever fought, and actually lost.
What happens when a government sends real machine guns after a bird, and loses?
The Emu War is not an internet joke. It was a real military operation, and the birds won.
In 1932 a decorated Australian army major was sent to defeat a few thousand birds, and radioed home defeated.

share_trigger: A viewer sends this to the friend who insists no army could ever lose to animals, because they want to prove Australia's real government machine-gunned emus and still lost.
contradicted_belief: Most people believe a real army with modern weapons could never actually lose a war to animals.
closing_comment: Major Meredith really told the Australian army that emus could face machine guns with the invulnerability of tanks, wild that this made it into an official 1932 report.

sources.note: Confirms Major Meredith's 1932 deployment, machine gun details, and his 'invulnerability of tanks' quote.
Confirms parliamentary mockery, ornithologist criticism, and the bounty system that replaced the military cull.
